meta.name: Working Systems Editorial Shelf
meta.description: A DevOps portfolio expressed as seven bound working volumes around the exact ThreeUI Complete Shelf experience.

primary.role: Copper foil, primary calls to action, focus, and volume metadata

secondary.role: Walnut contact surfaces, shelf material, and deep editorial grounding

accent.role: Antique-gold highlight on selected book editions

neutral.usage: Warm paper and ink establish the editorial profile; blue-black paper and warm white ink establish the immersive shelf and hero.

color.contrast_strategy: Warm dark-on-paper reading surfaces paired with high-contrast warm-white-on-blue-black immersive surfaces

font_families.heading: Iowan Old Style, Baskerville, Times New Roman, serif

typography.font_style_notes: Classical old-style serif gives the collection literary authority; compact Inter metadata keeps technical evidence contemporary and scannable.

spacing.section_rhythm: Large chapter openings followed by dense evidence lines and controlled folio metadata

layout.grid_system: Twelve-column editorial field with alternating two-column volume spreads
layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric editorial alignment with mirrored book-and-evidence spreads

shape.border_usage: Fine one-pixel folio rules and inset cover frames
shape.divider_style: Warm translucent hairlines that separate chapters and evidence rows

elevation.shadow_style: Long, warm book-object shadows with a hard offset underlay
elevation.depth_cues: Three.js book geometry, walnut shelving, physical materials, alternating cover perspective, paper overlap, and warm directional shadow

iconography.style: Minimal editorial arrows and authored line controls
iconography.preferred_set: Authored inline SVG controls from the canonical source

motion.entrance_pattern: Shelf binds into view, selected book advances, and editorial data crossfades
motion.exit_pattern: Book returns to its shelf position while interface layers resolve back to browse mode
motion.philosophy: Tactile editorial motion driven by physical book handling rather than decorative page animation

components.button_style: Round authored controls inside the shelf; copper rectangular editorial commands outside it
components.input_style: No form fields in this edition
components.card_style: Portfolio entries are bound book spreads, not detached cards
components.navigation_pattern: Compact same-origin portfolio access bar plus authored shelf index and sticky profile folio navigation
components.modal_style: Authored book detail panel with dialog semantics and page controls
components.list_style: Fine-ruled evidence rows with copper return arrows and compact technology colophons
components.component_notes: The canonical component remains unchanged; the profile reuses its exact palette, typography hierarchy, material metaphor, and seven-volume rhythm.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A small technical press publishing seven field volumes of engineering practice
aesthetic.era_influence: Mid-century editorial book design interpreted through contemporary Three.js product presentation

visual_language.ornamentation: Functional bookbinding details, foil rules, and folio metadata
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Expansive page margins isolate each volume and protect evidence readability
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: A single physical book balances a broad evidence column; direction alternates by chapter
visual_language.focal_strategy: Interactive shelf first, then progressive editorial disclosure across seven volumes
visual_language.texture_usage: Authored cloth, paper, foil, page-edge, wood, lighting, dust, and subtle physical-material response

composition.hierarchy_method: Serif scale, spatial isolation, folio rules, cover color, and small uppercase metadata
composition.flow_direction: Interactive collection to profile title to seven working volumes to direct contact
composition.grouping_strategy: Volumes, spreads, colophons, evidence rows, and edition metadata
composition.negative_space_role: Creates the pacing of a monograph and distinguishes claims from supporting evidence

imagery.photo_treatment: No photography; book covers and materials are generated as authored Three.js objects and CSS editions
imagery.illustration_style: Geometric foil motifs and technical book-cover composition
imagery.graphic_elements: Hardcovers, cloth spines, fine rules, edition numbers, copper foil, walnut shelving, and page folios
imagery.pattern_usage: Restrained inset cover rules and CanvasTexture artwork rather than repeating site patterns

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Selected books advance physically; supporting type and palette resolve with the selection
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Shelf books label on pointer proximity; profile covers settle from a shallow perspective angle
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Slow confident material glide with quick control confirmation
interaction_feel.loading_style: Authored Binding the collection indicator followed by WebGL or static catalog resolution

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Editorial, technically credible, calm, and evidence-led
brand_voice_in_ui.formality: Professional with a crafted independent-publisher voice
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Concise invitation: Enter portfolio, Open, Start a conversation
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Present the complete readable static catalog when interactive rendering is unavailable
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: State which volume is missing and return the reader to the shelf

overview.fallback_strategy: Use the canonical static seven-book catalog when WebGL fails; keep the separate profile fully semantic and renderer-independent
overview.primary_technology: Three.js r165, WebGL, CanvasTexture, DOM/CSS, and same-origin iframe customization

background_effects.description: A physically lit walnut shelf and room environment support seven bound book objects with atmospheric dust.
background_effects.technology: Three.js scene, PMREM room environment, fog, lights, and procedural textures

params.speed: Damped frame updates tied to authored interaction state
params.density: Seven detailed books plus shelf, environment, contact shadows, and dust field
params.opacity: Opaque scene with authored UI layers
params.blend_mode: Physically based material and light composition

particle_systems.description: A restrained dust volume reinforces shelf depth and room light.

3d_elements.description: Seven independently modeled tactile hardcovers can be selected, inspected, opened, orbited, and paged.

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer with alpha false, antialiasing, shadows, output color space, and tone mapping configured by the canonical source
params.lighting: Hemisphere, directional, rect-area key/fill/rim/spine/page lighting, PMREM room environment, and fog
params.camera: PerspectiveCamera with authored shelf, inspect, opening, and closing states
params.materials: MeshPhysicalMaterial cloth, cover, foil, paper, page edges, headbands, ribbons, and MeshStandardMaterial walnut
params.geometry: Rounded boxes, planes, custom shapes, page sheets, cylinders, grouped hinges, shelf meshes, and raycast hit volumes
params.interaction_model: Wheel and arrow selection, raycast hover, click-to-inspect, drag cover, click-to-open, page navigation, and background orbit

shader_effects.description: The source relies on Three.js physical materials and textures rather than a custom full-screen GLSL effect.

params.vertex_manipulation: Authored object transforms and page geometry
params.fragment_output: Physically based book, paper, foil, and walnut surfaces

scroll_morphing.description: The root viewport stays fixed; wheel input changes the selected volume instead of scrolling the document.

text_effects.description: Typography crossfades and shifts as interface state changes but remains intact semantic text.

cursor_effects.description: A small editorial pointer label identifies the hovered book volume and title.

image_effects.description: Profile book covers use shallow perspective and settle on hover to echo physical inspection.

canvas_drawings.description: CanvasTexture generators build cover, foil, spine, back, paper, bump, page, and edge artwork before upload to Three.js.

params.draw_method: Embedded cover atlas plus procedural editorial typography and material maps
params.animation_loop: requestAnimationFrame via the canonical Three.js frame loop
params.color_scheme: Per-volume paper, cloth, foil, ink, wall, and shelf palettes
params.responsiveness: Renderer and camera resize to the authored fixed viewport
params.interaction: Textures follow the selected and opened book state

svg_animations.description: SVG is limited to static authored control icons.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The canonical HTML is a self-contained fixed experience with embedded cover and wood assets, Three.js r165 imports, seven modeled books, wheel/keyboard/pointer state, open-book page mechanics, coarse-pointer breakpoints, reduced-motion handling, WebGL disposal, and a readable static fallback. The application does not rewrite that document; it uses the registered package component and exact configured typography/color props, then carries the same palette and bookbinding metaphor into a separate semantic CV profile.
